protocol.thread_config_scope: recorded ATC environment; benchmark process thread environment was not independently snapshotted
protocol.mean_definition: mean absolute element error; arithmetic mean over 20 equally shaped tensors
protocol.matching: score-ordered greedy best-IoU one-to-one pairing per image, without label filtering or minimum IoU requirement; not AP or handedness accuracy
protocol.timing: H2D + synchronous ACL execute + D2H; excludes preprocessing, decode and camera

results.reason: MaxPoolV3 DT_FLOAT input is not supported by the selected AIcoreEngine kernel in must_keep_origin_dtype mode; compiler reports DT_FLOAT16 support

limitations: No repeated cross-mode timing order; small latency differences are observational.
No human camera acceptance or ground-truth mAP assessment.
Do not infer false-positive or false-negative rates from ONNX agreement.
